metadata.title: OT Safety Overlay

props.name: overlay-scope
props.remarks: Specialization overlay applying to safety-critical operational technology and cyber-physical control systems.

props.name: authoritative-standard
props.remarks: Primary authoritative standard for OT security and safety.

props.name: supporting-guidance
props.remarks: Interpretive guidance aligning IEC 62443 with NIST frameworks.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Safety overlay constraining execution, command, change, access, and lifecycle behaviors to preserve physical safety.

metadata.remarks: The OT Safety Overlay constrains Secure-Device foundational patterns to ensure that cybersecurity controls and operational actions do not introduce unsafe physical conditions. In OT environments, safety overrides availability, performance, and operational convenience.

components.title: Safety Supremacy Constraint
components.description: Defines safety as the dominant operational priority over availability, recovery speed, or automation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cyber events must not cause unsafe equipment states.

components.title: Command Safety Constraint
components.description: Requires that all commands be evaluated for potential unsafe physical impact prior to execution.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Control system commands must be validated to prevent unsafe operation.

components.title: Change Safety Constraint
components.description: Constrains change introduction to ensure operational stability and process safety.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Changes are evaluated for impact on safety and reliability prior to implementation.

components.title: Engineering Access Safety Constraint
components.description: Restricts engineering access to prevent unsafe manipulation of control logic or parameters.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Privileged access to control functions is strictly controlled and monitored.

components.title: Safety Zones and Conduits Enforcement
components.description: Requires strict enforcement of safety zones and constrained conduits for OT systems.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Segmentation using zones and conduits is mandatory for safety.

components.title: Fail‑Safe Behavior Requirement
components.description: Defines expected safe-state behavior during faults, cyber events, or loss of control.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Systems must transition to a safe state during abnormal conditions.
